title: EpicReports
description: EpicReport is a lightweight and professional Minecraft moderation plugin for Paper and Spigot servers. It allows players to report rule breakers using a simple command system while automatically notifying staff members with clean alerts and title messages.
body:
EpicReport is a lightweight and professional Minecraft reporting plugin designed for Paper and Spigot servers. It allows players to report rule breakers easily using a simple command system while automatically notifying staff members with clean alerts and title messages.

The plugin includes an advanced temporary auto-ban system that activates when a player receives multiple reports from different users. Staff members can monitor reports efficiently, while players receive professional-looking warnings and ban screens.

EpicReport also supports Discord webhook logging, allowing server owners to track reports, punishments, and player activity directly inside Discord.

Main Features:
• Simple /EpicReport command system
• Professional title and chat alerts
• Staff notification system
• Automatic temporary bans
• Clean ban screen messages
• Discord webhook logging
• Lightweight and optimized performance
• Easy configuration
• Paper & Spigot support

Built for survival, SMP, and community servers that want a clean and modern moderation experience without heavy performance usage.
